newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's bourse resumes its higher trend.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's bourse resumes its higher trend.

text.p: Casablanca stock exchange closed on Tuesday 0.06 percent higher as largest capitalisation firms ONA Group and Societe Nationale d'Investissement made modest gains, stockbrokers said.
The bourse all-share index closed at 638.25 points from 637.87 points on Monday.
"Blue chips advanced slightly...More people were on the market compared with Monday's session but very low volumes were traded," a broker at BMCI Securities said.
First Moroccan private conglomerate, ONA rose 10 dirhams to 775 dirhams.
SNI, the second largest private group, edged up three dirhams to 728 dirhams.
Also gaining was second tranche of privatisation bonds, issued in May 1996, with up six dirhams to 1,178.
In the energy sector, oil refinery Samir took two dirhams to 354 dirhams with 6,000 shares traded, the broker said.
Silver mine Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter SMI.CS fell 17 dirhams to 578 dirhams with 1,710 shares traded.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur dipped 12 dirhams to 588 dirhams.
Total traded volume on the official market was 21 million dirhams from 25 million dirhams on Monday.
On the over-the-counter market, the volume was four million dirhams from 42 million dirhams on the previous session.
